WRITING TASK 2
Write about the following topic:
These days, there's no need to go to watch live performances (eg. a
show or a concert) because what we can see on TV or computer screens
is better.
To what extent do you agree or disagree?
Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from
your own knowledge or experience.
Write at least 250 words.

It's a pity you focused exclusively on music concerts. I'd say the
arguments for and against attending football matches or other sporting
events are more compelling. I'd also mention theatre.
I think a fully coherent position would be:
There's no doubt that modern broadcasts of concerts or sporting events
are excellent
fantastic images and sound
• the best possible view
with action replays and expert commentators in the case of sports
matches
However, attending a live event, whether musical, theatrical or sporting
provides a more unforgettable experience and atmosphere
• attending n FA Cup Final is something a football fan would remember
forever, while all the others would blend into one, with few highlights
to remember
